parsed.observations: Wheat leaves show extensive yellow longitudinal streaking and patches, with tan-brown dead tissue at some tips and margins. Distinct pustules, black dots within lesions, and white powdery growth are not clearly visible; a large text overlay obscures part of the foliage.
parsed.summary: The diagnosis is uncertain because leaf yellowing and necrosis are visible, but characteristic pustules or other disease-specific signs cannot be resolved.
